extension.description: Fixes VS Code's workspace search encoding limitation. Automatically searches EUC-JP, Shift_JIS, and UTF-8 files simultaneously without changing your settings.
views.multiEncodingSearch.name: Multi-Encoding Search
config.title: Multi-Encoding Search
config.encodings.description: List of character encodings to search simultaneously in parallel. Supports UTF-8, EUC-JP, Shift_JIS, UTF-16LE/BE, Windows-1252, GB18030, GBK, Big5, EUC-KR.
config.rgPath.description: ripgrep executable name or full path (bundled by default)
